units.source_text: 我想起上次回家时，父亲硬要下地刮胡子时的情景。

en.t: I remembered the scene the last time I went home, when Father insisted on getting out of bed to shave.

units.source_text: “我已经好啦，都是你妈大惊小怪给闹的，真是的。”

en.t: I am already better; this is all because your mother made such a fuss, honestly.

units.source_text: 我一想父亲那时说的话，又觉得不能完全责怪母亲，

en.t: When I thought of what Father had said then, I felt I could not entirely blame Mother either,

units.source_text: 所以，我本想说“不过，还是要多提醒他”，却终于忍住没有说出口，

en.t: so I wanted to say, But you still need to remind him more, yet in the end I held back and did not say it,

units.source_text: 只是给母亲讲了一通我所知道的有关父亲的这种病，需要注意些什么。

en.t: I merely told Mother what I knew about this illness of Father's and what needed attention.

units.source_text: 不过这些知识大多是从先生和夫人那儿听来的，

en.t: Most of this knowledge, however, was something I had heard from Sensei and his wife,

units.source_text: 母亲好像并没有特别上心，

en.t: and Mother did not seem to take it especially seriously,

units.source_text: 只是问道：“哟，还是一样的病啊，真可怜哪。

en.t: she only asked, Oh, so it was the same illness after all; how pitiful.

units.source_text: 那位老太太走的时候多大年纪啊？”

en.t: How old was that old lady when she passed away?

units.source_text: 没有办法，我只好放弃说服母亲，直接去跟父亲说。

en.t: Having no other choice, I gave up trying to persuade Mother and went directly to speak with Father.

units.source_text: 父亲比母亲听得要认真，然后说道：“嗯，是这么回事，你说的有道理。

en.t: Father listened more seriously than Mother and then said, Yes, that is how it is; what you say makes sense.

units.source_text: 不过，我自己的身子自己最了解，对我这身子该怎么保养，

en.t: But I know my own body best, and as for how this body of mine should be cared for,

units.source_text: 你爸我最有数，这么多年的经验了。”

en.t: your father knows that better than anyone, after so many years of experience.

units.source_text: 母亲听了，苦笑道：“你瞧瞧，怎么样？”

en.t: Hearing this, Mother gave a wry smile and said, See? What did I tell you?

units.source_text: “爸爸嘴上那么说，心里可是明明白白的。

en.t: Father may say that, but deep down he understands perfectly well.

units.source_text: 我这次毕业回家，他这么高兴，还不全是因为这个呀。

en.t: The reason he was so happy that I came home after graduating this time was surely just that.

units.source_text: 他本来以为自己病怏怏的，等不到我毕业呢，

en.t: He had thought that, being so sickly, he would not live to see my graduation,

units.source_text: 可是我在他还活着的时候，拿来了文凭，所以他特别高兴。

en.t: but I brought home my diploma while he was still alive, so he was especially happy.

units.source_text: 这是爸亲口对我说的。”

en.t: Father told me that himself.

units.source_text: “唉，你知道，他不过是嘴上这么说说罢了，

en.t: Ah, you know, he is only saying that with his mouth,

units.source_text: 心里还是不当回事。”

en.t: but in his heart he still does not take it seriously.
